name: Omarchy Auto Power
author: jfdnet
description: Battery-aware idle power management with a half-moon/full-moon bar toggle: auto suspend and poweroff on battery, respecting AC power and the stay-awake indicator (screensaver, lock, suspend and poweroff suppressed while awake).

barWidget.description: Half/full moon toggle for stay-awake (suppress screensaver, lock, suspend and poweroff on idle)
